compatible_range: Only this immutable compiler, with the unchanged gen3 server, is tested for this android-libxposed build path; no moving main
default_pin_not_moved_because: The acd4046 seed builds the gen3 server to different bytes (402,944 vs 399,360) and the server embeds the af376e8 pin in its capabilities text, so moving the default pin needs a verified server transaction and a re-accepted release
known_upstream_limits: Large modules can decline in native build until MrxSiN/XAX#53 (DEX writer output buffer) is merged; this pin predates it
A declining native build writes no diagnostic, so the server reports only compiler_rejected
